Die Hard Gamers is a gaming community based on fun rather than entirely on competitive multiplayer. That being said DHG members offer competitive teams along with sniping teams to satisfy the gamers with a more competitive side. DHG currently has 30,000 registered users on the DHG website.

Requirements: The requirements to be a DHG member are very simple, you must be 16 years of age or older, have a working mic, change your name sharing and bio, and have access to the Die Hard Gamers website

Squad requirements: DHG requires all members attend practices, at least 2 practices a week, along with 1 meeting a week. These practices are in no way competitive but rather are a means for all squad members to get together and play for at least an hour. Practices can be in Public matches or in Private matches.

Consoles: Xbox One and Xbox 360
